- heading "Test Automation Specialist" [level=2]
- heading "Uni Systems" [level=2]
- heading "Brussels, Belgium" [level=2]
- heading "Description" [level=3]
- paragraph: At Uni Systems, we are working towards turning digital visions into reality. We are continuously growing and we are looking for a Test Automation Specialist to join our UniQue team.
- heading "What will you be doing in this role?" [level=3]
- list:
  - listitem: Design, preparation and monitoring of automated tests.
  - listitem: Contribution to the development of a plan to integrate automated testing within the testing process.
  - listitem: Evaluation of the tools and technology for automation best fit to the project within the DevSecOps approach.
  - listitem: Creation of an approach and methodology for building a test automation architecture.
  - listitem: Design and development (new or modified) of test automation solutions that meet the business needs and apply continuous integration technologies, especially targeting backend/web service-based interfaces.
  - listitem: Enabling the transition of testing from a manual to an automated approach.
  - listitem: Creation of automated test reporting and metrics collection.
  - listitem: Assistance during relevant parts of testing, analysis, technical documentation, deployment, evaluation and reporting.
- heading "Requirements" [level=3]
- heading "What will you be bringing to the team?" [level=4]
- list:
  - listitem: Bachelor degree in IT and years 11 of experience in IT.
  - listitem: At least 1 year of specific expertise in Java.
  - listitem: At least 1 year of specific expertise in Web Services.
  - listitem: Good knowledge of test automation technologies, tools and techniques.
  - listitem: Experience in the creation of test automation solutions involving own programming.
  - listitem: Good knowledge of Test Management and Defect Tracking tools.
  - listitem: Experience in the test data management.
  - listitem: "Experience with scripting and programming: Java, Groovy."
  - listitem: Experience working with SQL and database servers.
  - listitem: Knowledge of Service Oriented Architecture.
  - listitem: Knowledge of Relational DBMS.
  - listitem: "Experience using continuous integration techniques and tools: Bamboo, Git."
  - listitem: "Experience using testing tools: SoapUI, Postman, Selenium WebDriver."
  - listitem: "Experience working with containerisation tools: Docker."
  - listitem: Familiarity with interoperability technology (e.g., web services, message-oriented middleware).
  - listitem: Fluent in English at least at a level B1.
